2608.04515.title: CARVE: Cross-Slice Anisotropic Reallocation of Visual Evidence for Efficient 3D Medical Volume Understanding
2608.04515.paper_summary: Slice-based MLLMs leverage mature 2D encoders by representing 3D volumes as sequences of 2D slices. However, this slice-wise formulation produces thousands of visual tokens that burden the LLM backbone, many of which capture overlapping visual evidence across adjacent slices. To understand how effectively a growing visual token budget improves performance, we perform scaling analyses on two 3D medical VQA benchmarks and find diminishing returns: cost keeps rising while accuracy saturates, and improving in-plane resolution is more effective than adding slices at comparable budgets. The budget should therefore be allocated more selectively rather than simply enlarged, yet most token compression methods are designed for 2D images or videos, where redundancy arises from spatial layout or temporal motion rather than from near-duplicate content along the depth axis. We present CARVE, a training-free framework that compresses visual tokens prior to LLM inference and casts token reduction as budget-constrained 2.5D allocation. CARVE partitions the depth axis into coherent windows and allocates tokens non-uniformly according to normalized cross-slice evidence. Under a shared budget, CARVE builds spatial anchors on representative slices and retrieves locally varying evidence from the full volume, then merges remaining eligible tokens into nearby anchors within each window. Removing roughly 80% of the visual tokens on Hulu-Med-7B, CARVE leads all compression baselines on every AMOS-MM report-generation metric, with 6.2 points higher retention of full-token quality than the strongest baseline, and preserves 98.1% of full-token performance across three VQA benchmarks.
2608.04515.paper_summary_zh: 基於切片的 MLLMs 利用成熟的 2D 編碼器，通過將 3D 體積表示為 2D 切片序列。<lb/>然而，這種切片式的表述產生了數千個視覺標記，這對 LLM 主幹造成了負擔，其中許多標記捕捉了相鄰切片之間的重疊視覺證據。<lb/>為了了解不斷增長的視覺標記預算如何有效提高性能，我們對兩個 3D 醫學 VQA 基準進行了擴展分析，發現收益遞減：成本不斷上升，而準確率則趨於飽和，改善平面分辨率比在可比預算下增加切片更有效。<lb/>因此，預算應該更具選擇性地分配，而不是簡單地擴大，然而大多數標記壓縮方法是為 2D 圖像或視頻設計的，這些情況下的冗餘源於空間佈局或時間運動，而不是來自深度軸上的近似重複內容。<lb/>我們提出了 CARVE，一個無需訓練的框架，在 LLM 推理之前壓縮視覺標記，並將標記減少視為受預算限制的 2.5D 分配。<lb/>CARVE 將深度軸劃分為一致的窗口，並根據標準化的跨切片證據不均勻地分配標記。<lb/>在共享預算下，CARVE 在代表性切片上建立空間錨點，並從整個體積中檢索局部變化的證據，然後將剩餘的合格標記合併到每個窗口內的附近錨點中。<lb/>在 Hulu-Med-7B 上去除約 80% 的視覺標記後，CARVE 在每個 AMOS-MM 報告生成指標上領先所有壓縮基準，保留的全標記質量比最強基準高出 6.2 分，並在三個 VQA 基準上保留 98.1% 的全標記性能。
